dependency_edges: same event: foreign residence, different antecedents
same event: overseas prosperity, different antecedents
timing model competitors, not independent time confirmations
may share traditional historical source; not independently collated Sanskrit
experiment_rules: Freeze original source astrological predicates, sign/house, D9/D60, Dasha selection before outcomes.
No participant chart or personal history used during preparation.
Use geographically and demographically matched non-astrological migration and income baselines.
Score failed forecasts, nonmigrants and missing dates; no direction switch after observed result.
Foreign status with travel, income and legal residence are correlated but must not multiply one event into several wins.
